name: Single Player Tarkov
author: cocomarti0208@gmail.com
description:
Single Player Tarkov (SPT) transforms your Escape From Tarkov (EFT) client into a fully offline experience.
No more server downtime, cheaters, or forced PvP. Enjoy realistic raids, quest progression, and steady character development on your own terms.

variables.name: SPT version
variables.description: Version of the SPT mod for the server. Use "latest" for latest release, or the github release/tag/hash. Require a server reinstall to modify the version.

variables.name: SPT asset name
variables.description: SPT mod release file's asset name.

variables.name: Github Username
variables.description: Optional, a Github username used to avoid Github API rate limit.

variables.name: Github OAuth token
variables.description: Optional, A Github OAuth token to use to avoid API rate limit.

variables.name: Wine
variables.description: If the server should download and run the windows version in case the user need mods that run only on windows like platform. To use this variable you need to change the Docker Image to wine and reinstall the server.

variables.name: Fika
variables.description: Decide whether or not to install SPT with FIKA preinstalled. Require a server reinstall to use.

install.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -euo pipefail  # Exit on error, undefined variables, and pipeline failures

# Initialize directorie
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server || exit 1

# Error handling function
handle_error() {
    echo "ERROR: Installation failed on line $1"
    exit 1
}

trap 'handle_error $LINENO' ERR

# GitHub API configuration
REPO_API="https://api.github.com/repos/AirryCo/spt-server-ci"
AUTH=""
if [ -n "${GITHUB_USER:-}" ] && [ -n "${GITHUB_OAUTH_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
    echo "Using authenticated GitHub API calls"
    AUTH="-u ${GITHUB_USER}:${GITHUB_OAUTH_TOKEN}"
fi

# Fetch GitHub data function
fetch_github_data() {
    local endpoint="$1"
    curl -s $AUTH "${REPO_API}/${endpoint}"
}

# Get download URL function
get_download_url() {
    local version="$1"
    local asset_type="$2"
    local fika="$3"
    
    if [ "$version" = "latest" ]; then
        fetch_github_data "releases/latest" | \
        jq -r --arg type "$asset_type" --arg fika "$fika" \
        '.assets[] | select(.name | test($type; "i")) | 
        select(if $fika == "true" then 
            (.name | test("-fika"; "i")) 
        else 
            (.name | test("-fika"; "i") | not) 
        end) | .browser_download_url'
    else
        fetch_github_data "releases" | \
        jq -r --arg version "$version" --arg type "$asset_type" --arg fika "$fika" \
        '.[] | select(.tag_name == $version) | .assets[] | 
        select(.name | test($type; "i")) | 
        select(if $fika == "true" then 
            (.name | test("-fika"; "i")) 
        else 
            (.name | test("-fika"; "i") | not) 
        end) | .browser_download_url'
    fi
}

# Determine asset type (linux/windows)
ASSET_TYPE="linux"
if [ -n "${IS_WINE:-}" ]; then
    ASSET_TYPE="win"
fi

# Determine version
VERSION="${SPT_VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$VERSION" != "latest" ]; then
    # Validate version exists
    if ! fetch_github_data "releases" | jq -e --arg version "$VERSION" '.[] | select(.tag_name == $version)' > /dev/null; then
        echo "Warning: Version $VERSION not found, falling back to latest"
        VERSION="latest"
    fi
fi

# Get download URL
DOWNLOAD_URL=$(get_download_url "$VERSION" "$ASSET_TYPE" "$FIKA")

# Validate URL before proceeding
if [ -z "$DOWNLOAD_URL" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: No download URL found for $ASSET_TYPE asset"
    exit 1
fi

# Download and extract
echo "Downloading ${SPT_NAME:-asset} from $DOWNLOAD_URL"
wget --show-progress -q -O "${SPT_NAME:-package.zip}" "$DOWNLOAD_URL"

echo "Extracting files..."
unzip -o "${SPT_NAME:-package.zip}"
rm -f "${SPT_NAME:-package.zip}"

if [ "$ASSET_TYPE" = "linux" ]; then 
    mv SPT.Server SPT.Server.exe
fi

# Set permissions
if [ -f "SPT.Server.exe" ]; then
    chmod +x "SPT.Server.exe"
else
    echo "Warning: SPT.Server.exe not found after extraction"
fi

echo "Installation completed successfully"
